integrity: The universal claim is analytic; the bundled finite computation is a consistency check and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Existence only; no classification is claimed.
The theorem is proved for primes \(p\ge5\) only.
Literature novelty remains subject to unindexed or differently phrased sources.
title: A nonseparable nontiling Gabor window over every odd prime field of order at least five
